top_signals.summary: Maritime Cybersecurity pioneer Cydome has extended its cybersecurity platform with a Third-Party Vendor Compliance and Risk Management solution. The new platform is designed to help shipowners, fleet managers, shipyards and third-party vendors manage the complexity around mandatory vendor cybersecurity regulatory compliance, certifications and approvals. top_signals.title: Liebherr Christens MV Patricia
top_signals.summary: Patricia Ruf, Member of the administrative board at Liebherr-International AG, has formally christened SAL's MV Patricia at the Liebherr site in Rostock. The vessel is the third delivered unit in SAL's Orca Class newbuilding program and bears the name of her godmother.
